user.title: gametools API
user.description: Battlefield 6 statistics come from the community API api.gametools.network. It is not an official EA service and needs no API key. Players are added to this entry later.

abort.already_configured: The gametools API entry already exists. Add players to that entry.

user.title: Find player
user.description: Enter the player name as shown in Battlefield 6 (EA name, Steam, PlayStation or Xbox name), at most {max} characters. Special characters are allowed. Several accounts can share a name; you pick the right one next.

select.title: Pick account
select.description: Accounts found for “{name}” that are not set up yet: {count}. Each line shows name, platform and the date the account was created; 🔒 marks an account that is not public.

error.cannot_connect: The gametools API did not answer. Try again later.
error.no_players: No player with this name was found.
error.no_stats: The gametools API has no Battlefield 6 statistics for this account. Pick another account or try again after a match.
error.invalid_name: Enter a name with 1 to {max} characters, without line breaks or other control characters.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The gametools API entry is not loaded. Reload it and try again.
abort.already_configured: All accounts with this name are already set up.

update_failed.message: The gametools API did not answer: {error}
